content:
Alex (Sales Eng): FYI NordicBank wants SIG completed by EOD Wed. We still need owners for network diagram, KMS rotation policy, and SOC2 evidence. Can folks pick up?
Ria (Solutions): I can do the data flow & encryption answers. Will upload diagrams to the evidence bucket.
Jamie (Security): I can grab the KMS rotation policy and the key lifecycle doc. Need to confirm whether they want HSM screenshots or just policy text.
Sam (AE): I'll ask the customer if they need a signed attestation or if a screenshot + primary contact is fine. Pinged them in the last call.
Maya (CS): I'll consolidate the customer-supplied attestations into one PDF once we have everything.
Alex (Sales Eng): Notes on locations: please put artifacts here: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/vendor-evidence/nordicbank and s3://redwood-evidence/nordicbank/<your-name>/ — use clear filenames e.g. `kms-rotation-policy-v1.pdf`
Ria (Solutions): uploading initial diagram now. small note: we have two variants (hosted API vs dedicated). Nordics asked for Dedicated deployment diagram. I'll include both and label which is which.
Jamie (Security): quick question — do we need AWS KMS key rotation logs or just the policy doc? If logs, I can pull CloudTrail snippet limited to the CMK ARN.
Alex (Sales Eng): Customer asked for proof of rotation policy + a recent rotation event. So both policy + one CloudTrail entry should be fine (redact ARNs where needed).
Sam (AE): Customer contact replied: attestation can be a PDF signed by their CISO or a formal statement from their procurement. They prefer a signed doc — I'll push for the latter.
Jamie (Security): Uploaded `kms-rotation-policy-v2.pdf` to s3 and added a CloudTrail snippet `ct-rotation-snippet.txt`. Path: s3://redwood-evidence/nordicbank/jamie/security/
Ria (Solutions): Uploaded `nordic-dedicated-arch.svg` and `data-flow-annotated.pdf` to my folder. Also added notes about the network segmentation.
Alex (Sales Eng): Thanks. @Maya can you stitch the artifacts? Also we need the SIG question Q3.2 (encryption at rest) answer text. Should be a short line + link to the policy.
Maya (CS): Will compile into `NordicBank_SIG_package_2024-04-23.pdf` once I have Jamie + Ria docs. ETA 3pm PST.
jira-bot: Created ticket SIG-3287 for this evidence pack and linked S3 artifacts.
Sam (AE): Heads-up: POC kickoff depends on this. If SIG not done by Wed EOD, the security team at NordicBank will block Dedicated infra provisioning.
Jamie (Security): I'll also add a short justification snippet for redaction: `We redact customer IDs and ARNs in exported logs per internal policy`. Put that in `redaction-notes.txt`.
Ria (Solutions): One blocker — I don't have a current network diagram for Dedicated in the latest repo. Using the deployed topology from last quarter; tagging @Alex to confirm no infra changes since then.
Alex (Sales Eng): No infra changes. Good to use last quarter diagram with an added annotation for the private subnets we added in Feb.
Maya (CS): Stitching in progress. If anyone needs me to modify filenames or change order, tell me now.
Sam (AE): Quick ask: pricing team needs to know whether the customer will request an on-prem package (higher support tier) or just VPC private. I'll confirm on the call later today.
Alex (Sales Eng): For SIG answers, note we should avoid posting raw keys or screenshots with secrets. Use sanitized screenshots and policy docs.
Jamie (Security): Agreed. I sanitized the CloudTrail snippet and replaced account IDs with `acct-REDACTED`.
Maya (CS): Final package draft uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/nordicbank/final/NordicBank_SIG_package_draft.pdf
Ria (Solutions): Quick sample command I ran to list artifacts:
```
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-evidence/nordicbank/ --recursive
2024-04-23 10:05:12  2048 nordicbank/jamie/security/kms-rotation-policy-v2.pdf
2024-04-23 10:06:01   512 nordicbank/jamie/security/ct-rotation-snippet.txt
2024-04-23 10:12:33  4096 nordicbank/ria/diagrams/nordic-dedicated-arch.svg
2024-04-23 10:12:40  1024 nordicbank/ria/diagrams/data-flow-annotated.pdf
2024-04-23 10:45:00  8192 nordicbank/final/NordicBank_SIG_package_draft.pdf
```
Alex (Sales Eng): Perfect. Can we aim to have the final package in Confluence and S3 by 5pm PST? I'll loop in Pricing after Sam confirms deployment type.
Sam (AE): Confirmed — I'll update by noon.
Maya (CS): If no other comments, I'll finalize at 4:30pm and mark the ticket SIG-3287 ready for review. :thumbsup:
Jamie (Security): One last note — I'll attach the SOC2 extract (control mapping) but not the full SOC2 report — customer's legal asked for summarized control mapping only. Uploaded `soc2-control-mapping.pdf`.
Alex (Sales Eng): Great work team. I'll send a short note to the customer to set expectations.
Maya (CS): Done. Message sent.
Sam (AE): Thanks everyone.
